bone.purpose: The action and focus colour: primary fill, the 2px focus outline, the focused tile's ring and ticks, a selected chip, a picked menu row, the active tab's underline, body text.

bone-2.purpose: Second-tier text that still reads over art: role lines, summaries in panels, menu sublines, the build card's line.

bottle.purpose: The held state: the focused menu row, an equipped proof row, a filled Player 2 ring, a completed desk step, matched-term plates. Never a call to action.

bottle-2.purpose: Scrollbar thumb, text selection, the edge of a completed step.

bronze.purpose: Trophy tier. Medals, the build card's finish, finish swatches, the Player 2 ring's edge. Nowhere else.

silver.purpose: Trophy tier. Medals, the build card's finish, finish swatches, the Player 2 ring's edge. Nowhere else.

gold.purpose: Trophy tier. Medals, the build card's finish, finish swatches, and the trophy glyph in the system bar. Nowhere else.

platinum.purpose: Trophy tier and the level clear's medal. Medals, the build card's finish, finish swatches. Nowhere else.

ink.purpose: The ground of every page, the stage behind the art, the sticky tabs, the build card. Scrims over art are ink at rising alpha.

lacquer.purpose: The opaque panel surface: toasts, the level clear card, drawers, the phone action bar. Over art laid at 0.6 to 0.9 alpha, never blurred.

lacquer-2.purpose: Image wells behind tiles and app icons before the art arrives.

ash.purpose: Tertiary text: labels, tier suffixes, stat keys, captions, inactive tabs, Skip. About 6.7:1 on ink.

ash-2.purpose: Placeholders and the empty Player 2 ring. About 4.5:1 on ink; nothing goes dimmer.

hair.purpose: Every divider and the outline of tiles and films. Bone at 0.14.

hair-2.purpose: The top edge of a raised panel, the outline of chips, status pills, the Player 2 slot, the stat divider. Bone at 0.24.

display.purpose: The name on the title screen, two stacked lines of Cormorant 600 capitals tracked 0.12em.

logotype.purpose: The focused title's name and screen names (Trophies, a player's build, the profile name). On phones tracking tightens to 0.06 to 0.08em.

headline.purpose: The title screen's questions, the build step's heading, the level clear's trophy name (54px, 0.14em), deck slides.

title.purpose: Trophy group heads over a hairline; drawer heads at 38px.

numeral.purpose: The two stats under a title and the profile's level, in lining tabular figures.

lead.purpose: The focused title's summary and the profile bio, up to 62ch. Bullets run 17px at 1.6 to 66ch.

button.purpose: Buttons, the system bar name (18px), menu row titles (19px), tile names (16px, 19px focused).

label.purpose: Small tracked capitals in ash that key a section, a control group or a value. Never a kicker above a headline.

caption.purpose: Stat keys, fine print, figure captions, the control legend (in bone-2).

shadows.name: lacquer-panel
shadows.purpose: The trophy rack, the build preview, Obavia's sent card: one bone hairline on top, a black outline, a long soft drop.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: The lacquer-panel recipe at 0.4 and 0.55 for toasts.

shadows.name: level-clear
shadows.purpose: The one card that owns the whole screen.

shadows.name: medal-drop
shadows.purpose: A filter on every medal raster.

shadows.name: bar-edge
shadows.purpose: The phone action bar, Obavia's get bar, the send panel.

shadows.name: type-over-art-logo
shadows.purpose: A text-shadow on logotypes set over key art.

shadows.name: type-over-art-summary
shadows.purpose: A text-shadow on summaries set over key art.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: The bone focus outline on every control. On Obavia it breathes between bone and bone at 0.6.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one ease for every transition and entrance in the library. Settles, never overshoots.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hovers and state changes on buttons, chips, rows.

motion.name: duration-focus
motion.purpose: Focus moving along the shelf: tile size, ring, ticks.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: translateY(14px) to none, opacity 0 to 1, 0.6s to 0.7s
motion.purpose: The title head, the trophy rack (0.1s later), screens, the sent card, lessons.

motion.name: fade-phone
motion.purpose: On phones, where a fixed action bar sits on screen, the title head, screens and the rack only fade: a transform would capture the bar.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The focused tile's ring and PRESS START. The only symmetrical ease-in-out in the library.

motion.name: dolly
motion.value: scale(1) to scale(1.02), 20s (30s on the title screen)
motion.purpose: Key art drifting in; plates cross-fade over 0.9s.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toasts sliding in from the right under the bar.

motion.name: coin
motion.value: rotateY(-180deg) to 0 in perspective(300px), 0.9s (1.4s on the level clear)
motion.purpose: A medal turning a half turn into place as a sheen passes over it.

motion.name: mint
motion.purpose: The build card arriving like a reward.

motion.name: strike
motion.purpose: The build card's four proofs striking in one by one; a 1.6s glint crosses the frame.

motion.name: grain
motion.purpose: Static film grain drifting over the stage.

motion.name: desk-push
motion.purpose: Desk demo screens pushing in from the right inside the phone. No overshoot.

motion.name: desk-settle
motion.purpose: The scanned licence settling in the desk demo.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Loops, dolly, grain, mint, strike and glint removed; the card shows finished.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the level pill, the email item and the trophy count leave the system bar.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the composition reflows; tiles 76px (96px focused) and snap, the title actions become a fixed lacquer bar, the rack and legend hide, the bar is 60px.

breakpoints.name: laptop
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: the full console composition; the build step hides menu sublines so the list holds one screen.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: max-height: phones drop the title summary; laptops lift the build step and tighten its list.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one bone action in a group: Open, Start, Enter the library. A 3px plate, never a pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 3px; font: 500 16px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); min-width: 148px; border: 1px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); background: var(--bone, #ede7db); color: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fff8ec; border-color: #fff8ec; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary--lg { min-height: 54px; min-width: 200px; padding: 0 30px; font-size: 18px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action beside the primary: transparent with a bone outline at 0.7.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 3px; font: 500 16px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); border: 1px solid rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.7); background: transparent; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.08); border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No outline, bone-2 text; Back at the top left of every open screen. Hover shows a strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 3px; font: 500 16px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--bone-2, #d9d2c4); } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--hair-2, rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.24)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Radio pills for one role, one lot problem or one finish. Selected is a bone fill with ink text; a finish not yet earned is dashed.
components.css: .ds-chip-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip, .ds-fin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-2, rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.24)); border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(17, 27, 23, 0.7); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 500 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-fin:hover { border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-chip:focus-visible, .ds-fin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-chip:active, .ds-fin:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip.is-on { background: var(--bone, #ede7db); color: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-fin { padding: 0 15px 0 12px; background: none; } .ds-fin i { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45), inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); } .ds-fin.is-on { border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); background: rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.08); } .ds-fin[aria-disabled="true"] { color: var(--ash, #9a9890); border-style: dashed; cursor: default; } .ds-fin[aria-disabled="true"] i { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: A bone underline and no box: the name on the title screen and the signature on the build screen. Focus thickens the line to 2px. Multiline text uses the boxed field.
components.css: .ds-field-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 22px; } .ds-field { width: min(360px, 100%); height: 50px; padding: 0 2px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); border-radius: 0; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); caret-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 500 22px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--ash-2, #7d7b74); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-field-box { width: min(420px, 100%); padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.7); border: 1px solid var(--hair-2, rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.24)); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 15px/1.5 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; resize: vertical; transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-field-box:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Sections inside an open title, sticky on an ink band. Ash words; the active one is bone with a 2px bone underline. Q and E key caps bracket them.
components.html: QOverviewFilmPlay the sale deskTrophiesLoadoutE
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 20px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ash, #9a9890); font: 500 15px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tabs a:hover, .ds-tabs a.is-on { color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-tabs a.is-on::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 2px; height: 2px; background: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-key { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 28px; height: 24px; margin: 0 6px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.55); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 500 12px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: The title screen's menus: Who's playing, then the build step. The row under the cursor is bottle with a bone edge; the picked row flips to bone with ink text.
components.css: .ds-menu-ground { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font: 400 16px/1.55 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 10px; width: min(560px, 100%); } .ds-menu-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; text-align: left; background: rgba(17, 27, 23, 0.74); border: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.14)); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-menu-row:hover, .ds-menu-row.is-on { background: var(--bottle, #1c3229); border-color: var(--bone, #ede7db); } .ds-menu-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-menu-row:active, .ds-menu-row.is-picked { background: var(--bone, #ede7db); color: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-menu-row:active small, .ds-menu-row.is-picked small { color: #2c3a33; } .ds-menu-n { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-menu-txt { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-menu-txt b { font: 500 19px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-txt small { font: 400 14px/1.35 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--bone-2, #d9d2c4); }

components.name: Shelf Tile
components.description: The library row: square key art on a lacquer-raised well. The focused tile grows to 162px and wears a breathing 3px bone ring outset 8px plus two corner ticks. The gradient stands in for the art.
components.html: Triple J AutoLead to TitleProspector
components.css: .ds-shelf { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 30px; padding: 28px 28px 32px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-tile { display: grid; gap: 14px; padding: 8px; margin-top: 12px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: margin .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tile-frame { position: relative; display: block; width: 136px; height: 136px; border-radius: 6px; transition: width .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), height .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tile-img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--lacquer-2, #16221d); background-image: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 60% 30%, #233a2f 0%, #14211c 55%, #0b110f 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair, rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.14)), 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); transition: filter .3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tile-frame::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -8px; border-radius: 11px; border: 3px solid var(--bone, #ede7db); opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.97); pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), transform .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tile-frame::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -14px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); background: linear-gradient(var(--bone, #ede7db), var(--bone, #ede7db)) right top / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--bone, #ede7db), var(--bone, #ede7db)) right top / 2px 12px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--bone, #ede7db), var(--bone, #ede7db)) left bottom / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--bone, #ede7db), var(--bone, #ede7db)) left bottom / 2px 12px no-repeat; } .ds-tile-name { font: 400 16px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: font-size .36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-tile.is-focus, .ds-tile:hover, .ds-tile:focus-visible { margin-top: 0; } .ds-tile.is-focus .ds-tile-frame, .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-frame, .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-frame { width: 162px; height: 162px; } .ds-tile.is-focus .ds-tile-frame::after, .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-frame::after, .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-frame::after { opacity: 1; transform: none; animation: ds-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-tile.is-focus .ds-tile-frame::before, .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-frame::before, .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-frame::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-tile.is-focus .ds-tile-name, .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-name, .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-name { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-img { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-tile.is-focus:not(:hover) { margin-top: 12px; } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-tile.is-focus:not(:hover) .ds-tile-frame { width: 136px; height: 136px; } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-tile.is-focus:not(:hover) .ds-tile-frame::after, .ds-shelf:hover .ds-tile.is-focus:not(:hover) .ds-tile-frame::before { opacity: 0; animation: none; } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-tile.is-focus:not(:hover) .ds-tile-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.82; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile-frame::after { animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Trophy Rack
components.description: Bottom right of the home screen: a 250px lacquer panel lit by one bone hairline, listing the focused title's trophies as minted medals. Metal appears only here, on medals.
components.html:
Trophies in this title

  • Fifty-ThreeGold
  • ProceedsGold
  • Keys to the LotSilver
  • Title RunBronze
components.css: .ds-rack-ground { padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-rack { width: 250px; padding: 16px 18px; background: rgba(17, 27, 23, 0.9); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(237, 231, 219, 0.24), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); animation: ds-rise .7s .1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1) both; } .ds-rack-h { margin: 0 0 16px; font: 400 16px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rack ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-rack li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; } .ds-rack li span { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-rack b { font: 400 15px/1.25 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rack small { font: 400 12px/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--bone-2, #d9d2c4); } .ds-medal { flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)); } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rack { animation: none; } }

components.name: Build Card
components.description: The signature component: a 4 by 5 card sized entirely in container units so it matches the 1080 by 1350 PNG. Ink shades over the art, a metal double frame in the chosen finish, Cormorant names, four proofs with medals, the level and signature at the foot. It mints in on arrival.
components.css: .ds-bcard-ground { padding: 28px; background: var(--ink, #0a0f0d); } .ds-bcard { --fin: var(--bronze, #9c6b43); position: relative; width: 340px; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; container-type: inline-size; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--bone, #ede7db); background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.86) 0%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.5) 50%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.12) 85%), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 60% 30%, #233a2f 0%, #14211c 55%, #0b110f 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); animation: ds-mint 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1) both; } .ds-bcard::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.55) 0%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0) 16%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0) 36.8%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.82) 48%, rgba(10, 15, 13, 0.97) 80%); narrative.overview:
The site is a flagship game console's home screen after close, and Jason's career is the library on it. Each title (Triple J Auto, Lead to Title, The Inbound, Prospector, Neuroscience, and Obavia as a small side quest) owns one piece of full-bleed cinematic key art, and the interface around it is the console's quiet chrome: a system bar, a shelf of square tiles, the focused title's logotype, role, summary and two stats, a trophy rack, a control legend. The room is dark, the art is lit, and the chrome stays out of the art's way.

The UI is achromatic on purpose. Grounds are green-black ink and lacquer, type and edges are bone, held states are bottle green from the suit in the headshot, and every hue a visitor sees comes from the key art (sodium amber, wet asphalt, a bottle-green night) or from a trophy's minted metal. Density is one title at a time: the home screen is a fixed composition, not a scroll, and an opened title or screen becomes its own page laid over the dimmed art in a single left-aligned column. Motion is slow and sure: one ease, nothing bounces or shakes, and the focus ring breathes. The world refuses the scrolling resume, the neon gamer HUD, and the effects-heavy dash that preceded it (retired; nothing from it survives).

This file governs the library world: the home page (index.html, generated from tools/site/home.body.html, styled by game.css, build.css and desk.css) and /obavia.html (game.css, desk.css, obavia.css). Two other worlds ship on the same domain and are not governed here. The proof pages (credentials, answers, profile, knowledge card, mentions, honor, search) use tokens.css and proof.css: an older world with its own lacquer, a gold chromatic accent, ivory type, pill buttons and overshooting springs. The resume pages (resume-pdf.html and resume/*.html) use resume.css: a print-first US Letter sheet, near-black on white, title case with no tracking, static fonts. Neither should borrow from this file, and this file should not borrow from them.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed graded key art behind everything; its dark left side is where the type lives.
Achromatic chrome: ink grounds, bone actions and focus, bottle green for what is held.
Metal only on trophies: bronze, silver, gold, platinum medals and the build card's frame.
Tracked Cormorant Garamond capitals name things; Hanken Grotesk does all the reading.
Matte, near-opaque lacquer panels lit by one bone hairline on the top edge. No glass.
Square tiles with a breathing bone focus ring and two corner ticks.
One ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); motion that settles, never overshoots.

rules.name: The Key Art Carries the Colour Rule
rules.body: The chrome has no chromatic accent. Hue comes from the graded key art behind it; when a control needs emphasis it gets bone, not a colour.

rules.name: The Metal Means a Trophy Rule
rules.body: Bronze, silver, gold and platinum appear only where a trophy or the build card's finish is being shown. A metal on a button, a link or a heading is a bug.

rules.name: The Bottle Holds, Bone Acts Rule
rules.body: Bottle green marks what is held or chosen; bone marks what you can act on and where focus is. A row can be bottle with a bone edge; a button is never bottle.

rules.name: The Logotype Rule
rules.body: The name of a thing (a title, a screen, the person) is Cormorant capitals at 600 tracked 0.12em; secondary heads in the same voice drop to 500. On phones tracking tightens to 0.06 to 0.08em so a long name holds one or two lines.

rules.name: The Grotesk Does the Talking Rule
rules.body: Every sentence, every control and every figure that is chrome (the clock, the trophy count, step and menu numbers) is Hanken Grotesk. The serif only names things and sets the figures that are the point.

rules.name: The Label Is a Key Rule
rules.body: Small tracked capitals label a section, a control group or a value. They never sit above a headline to introduce it.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: A raised panel is lit by one bone hairline on its top edge. No border all round, no glow, no coloured edge.

rules.name: The Scrim Not Glass Rule
rules.body: Over art, legibility comes from ink scrims on the art and from near-opaque lacquer. Never backdrop blur, never a frosted panel.

rules.name: The Pill Is a Choice or a Status Rule
rules.body: Pills are only for things you pick and for status capsules. A button that does something is a 3px plate.

dos: **Do** keep the chrome achromatic: ink grounds, bone for actions and focus, bottle green for held states.
**Do** name titles, screens and the person in Cormorant Garamond 600 capitals tracked 0.12em, and set everything else in Hanken Grotesk.
**Do** use the one ease, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), for every transition and entrance; keep symmetrical ease-in-out for the 2.4s breathe loop only.
**Do** raise a panel with the lacquer recipe: near-opaque lacquer, one bone hairline on the top edge, a long soft black shadow.
**Do** compose key art with its mass to the right and calm shadow on the left for type, graded through the one recipe (tools/art/grade.py), with no people, readable text, signage, logos or neon.
**Do** size the build card in container units so the page and the 1080 by 1350 PNG are the same card.
**Do** let phone entrances fade only wherever a fixed bar sits on screen.
**Do** honour reduced motion: stop the loops, the dolly, the grain and the mint, and show every scene finished.
donts: **Don't** add a chromatic UI accent: no red, no blue links, no coloured buttons. The retired dash's red does not come back, not even inside the desk demo.
**Don't** put a metal on anything that is not a trophy or the build card's finish.
**Don't** use backdrop blur, frosted panels or a gradient on text.
**Don't** set a small tracked label above a headline as a kicker.
**Don't** round a button into a pill, or square off a choice chip.
**Don't** let anything bounce or overshoot, including the desk demo's iOS screens.
**Don't** use a font other than Cormorant Garamond and Hanken Grotesk.
**Don't** use em dashes, en dashes, emoji as icons, or three-card rows.
**Don't** let the proof pages' gold accent and springs, or the resume pages' print sheet, leak into the library.
